beginning.title: Where it began
beginning.summary: SureWord, first called VerseMind, arrived on Android as a full native app on the same account as the web. These first eighteen releases came in ten days.
items: Chat answers grounded in the King James Bible, with the verses they stand on.
Notes with folders, tags and a rich editor, and an assistant that can write into them.
The Bible tab: all 66 books of the KJV, offline, with tap-a-verse explanations.
The new name, SureWord, and the day star logo from 2 Peter 1:19.
Memory you control, attachments in chat, and your choice of AI model.
Pick Up Your Cross, the guided daily walk, with a reading history.
Hebrew and Greek word study and cross-references drawn from real texts.

1.104.0.title: Getting to know you
1.104.0.headline: SureWord learns your walk with God.
1.104.0.why: The welcome now asks whether you have been saved, and the word saved opens what it means, straight from the King James Bible. It also asks how long you have walked with the Lord and invites your testimony, so every answer, prayer and morning verse is made for where you are.

verse.text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

1.103.0.title: Spanish and German
1.103.0.headline: The Word, in your own language.
1.103.0.why: A closed tester asked for more languages. SureWord now answers in Spanish and German, following your phone's language unless you choose another in Settings, and the Reina-Valera 1909 and the Lutherbibel 1912 are in the Bible tab, free and offline.

verse.text: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

1.101.0.title: Walk with me
1.101.0.headline: SureWord welcomes you in, one tap at a time.
1.101.0.why: New accounts are now welcomed by SureWord itself, with big cards to tap instead of type, a gold spotlight that shows each part of the app, and Read it to me for anyone who would rather listen. Text size and a help button on every screen are there for everyone.

verse.text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

1.100.0.title: Quiz me
1.100.0.headline: Hide the chapter you just read in your heart.
1.100.0.why: A closed tester asked for a quiz after a study. At the end of any chapter you can now take five questions on it, and every answer, right or wrong, shows you the verse it came from.

verse.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

1.99.1.title: Smoother sign-in
1.99.1.headline: Sign in once, and step back when you need to.
1.99.1.why: Some testers saw an error flash right after signing in, because one tap and the Enter key both sent the sign-in. Now only the first one counts, and Back moves through the steps instead of closing the app.

1.99.0.title: Easier sign-in
1.99.0.headline: Create an account or sign in, your way.
1.99.0.why: New testers typed their email and were told no account existed, with no way to make one. The first screen now offers Create an account and Sign in, with Google under both.

1.98.0.title: What's new
1.98.0.headline: Every update, all in one place.

verse.text: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

1.97.1.title: Today stays clear
1.97.1.headline: Read today's word, one tap away.
1.97.1.why: On a narrow phone, a longer daily verse pushed the Read today's word button under the tab bar. The preview now stays at three lines, and the full passage is still in the devotional.

1.97.0.title: Today and Study
1.97.0.headline: A clearer way to begin each day in the Word.

verse.text: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

1.96.0.title: Connections
1.96.0.headline: See how Scripture is woven together.

verse.text: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

1.95.0.title: Smoother and steadier
1.95.0.headline: A steadier SureWord.
1.95.0.why: A full performance and stability pass across the app, so a dropped connection or a broken screen no longer stops your study.

1.94.0.title: Coming up at church
1.94.0.headline: Know what is happening at your church.

verse.text: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

1.92.0.title: Send a word to someone
1.92.0.headline: Send someone the word they need.

verse.text: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

1.88.1.title: Your own questions again
1.88.1.why: The Chat home had fallen back to the same six starter questions for everyone. It reads your own study again.

1.85.0.title: Your walk
1.85.0.headline: See your walk through the Word.

verse.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

1.56.0.title: Learn a verse
1.56.0.headline: Hide the Word in your heart.

verse.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
